name: The Wyrmspine
subtitle: The Climb at Golden Hour
author: Luminati
description: Chapter two of Vanquish the Evil Dragon: the long climb from Sunhallow to the Ashen Throne at golden hour — the red canyon, the chasm bridge, the switchbacks, the old watchtower, the Field of Bones and the Cinder Vents — through six waves of the dragon's brood, to Vorthrax himself. objects.name: The Old Watchtower
text: The tower's stair has fallen in. Old arrows still stand in the walls.

objects.name: Garrick
talk: Garrick: I heard it land. The whole mountain heard it land. #line:205DB8DA3AAA4198D844D37D6FE863D5
Garrick: You're Sunhallow's heroes, then. I held this tower as long as I could. #line:1C7AC917887097223F1AC160D1873B92
- The brood came down off the Throne like a rockslide. Little ones — but so many. #line:3C0CE21F6AA96CBA29ADDC21462EF356
- Rest by the stone if you need it. It still remembers how to heal. #line:6EEE2211DF5CC46463943111A1817934
